responsibility: Implements the low-level operations for IPA reference lists that connect symtab nodes. It removes references, preserves list consistency when aliases are involved, and exposes the basic accessors that higher-level callgraph and variable analyses use to traverse referring and referred nodes.
same_name_distinction: Provides the small set of concrete methods for the generic ipa_ref/ipa_ref_list structures from ipa-ref.h—especially reference removal and list maintenance with alias ordering—rather than defining the reference-edge data model or performing the higher-level static-variable analysis in ipa-reference.c.
